checkout.label: bean-box checkout (derived draft)
local_semantics: The clone makes no runtime request to beanbox.com or any external origin.
Checkout accepts only documented synthetic local fixtures and never collects or transmits real payment credentials.
Preparation, taste, quantity, cadence and plan choices persist through review and local checkout.

network.notes: Only local verifier/candidate hostnames are expected.
